name: Branching choices with flags
oneLiner: After a line of dialogue, a small window of 2 to 4 options opens beside the text box: arrows move a hand cursor, Z / tap picks, an option the player cannot take yet is grey and says why ("Need 10 gold"), and an optional countdown picks a default. Picks set flags (gold, metElder, plan) that later lines check with conditions like gold>=10 && !metElder, jump to labels and rejoin; once-only lines and options are remembered. The script is plain data the designer edits, a validator reports unreachable labels and unknown flags, and flags save as plain JSON. Drives the H-01 dialogue box, or the game's own text box through a three-function adapter.
fits: top-down adventure and RPG (villagers, quests, shops that remember)
turn-based RPG battle (a pre-battle plan, a boss bargain)
visual-novel style scenes inside a game
any game that already has a text box and wants choices on top of it
notFor: full dialogue trees edited in a node editor or loaded from external tools (the script is a plain JS object)
free text input or parser-style conversations
real-time dialogue wheels that keep the world running

needs: a text box: a GameDNA_DialogueBox (H-01) instance passed as box, or the game's own text box behind a three-function adapter (show one line, call done when the player advances, give its rect)
the game's existing talk function, in update logic: start(name, {onEnd}) there; what ran after the old talk moves into onEnd
input (directions, confirm, cancel, pointer) routed to the module while busy (box mode) or while choosing (adapter mode), on key-down edges
a fixed 60 Hz update step (the module's only clock), also while the world is paused for the talk
the play field size in native px and ui rects to keep clear (HUD, menus)
optional: the game's autoplay flag, its save / load (getFlags / setFlags), game effects for flags (onFlag)
provides: busy / choosing flags: pause the world and route input while a talk or its menu is open
a flag store (get, set, inc, check(condition), onFlag) the game reads and writes; getFlags / setFlags as plain JSON for save systems
talk end via onEnd({conv, lines, choices, path, skipped, auto, flags}) and each pick via onChoice, synchronous inside update()
validate(script): unreachable labels, goto targets without a label, flags read but never set, bad conditions
the menu rectangle on screen (menuRect), for other overlays to avoid

params.label: Which talks branch and what the choices change (required; the designer's words)
params.default: the main quest giver: accept the quest, ask about the reward, or ask for advice (once each); the advice gives a small bonus, and the reward question changes what they say when you return

params.label: Menu side (auto = right of the text box, away from the speaker)
Default countdown in ms (0 = wait for the player; a line's own timeout wins)
Menu window colour (a blue, n slate, b red)

assets: module/dialogue-choices.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_DialogueChoices): script walker (if, once, set, inc, goto, end, {$flag}), condition parser (no eval), flag store, choice menu with cursor, disabled reasons, countdown, autoplay, placement, validator, drawing with the C-03 6x8 font built in
uses module/dialogue-box.js of H-01 in box mode (not bundled; the game's own text box works through the adapter)
no image or audio files (sound cue names come back through onSfx)
